item.text: I have the main split: persistent Gaza mediation and a lawful two-state/ceasefire line on one side, versus arms shipments to Somalia, Sinai mobilization, and an airshow on the other. I’m checking one final source for the formal ceasefire framework and then I’ll synthesize.

item.text:
**Assessment**
Sisi’s 2024 record is mixed. On Gaza, Egypt clearly pushed a ceasefire, hostage release, and UN-backed mediation track, which is evidence for a more lawful and stable diplomatic posture. But Egypt also sent weapons to Somalia, raised military readiness in Sinai, and staged a large airshow showcasing force. Net: I do not see strong evidence that he left regional relations broadly more peaceful or lawful than he inherited them, even though he did help contain one major conflict channel.

**Claims**
- **Joint Statement from Egypt, Qatar and the United States** | Presidency of the Republic of Egypt | **Aug. 16, 2024** | https://www.presidency.eg/en/%D9%82%D8%B3%D9%85_%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1/%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%B1%D8%A6%D8%A7%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A9/news1682024/  
  Egypt co-led a bridging proposal for a Gaza ceasefire and hostage/detainee release deal, explicitly tied to UNSC Resolution 2735 and humanitarian provisions. This is the strongest evidence that Sisi pursued a stabilizing, law-based regional role in 2024.  
  **QIDs:** 2B.10, 2B.7, 2B.6

- **Joint Statement by President Biden, President Abdelfattah Said Elsisi of Egypt, and Amir Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani of Qatar** | The American Presidency Project | **Aug. 8, 2024** | https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/joint-statement-president-biden-president-abdelfattah-said-elsisi-egypt-and-amir-tamim-bin  
  The statement says the three leaders had worked for months on a framework agreement, called for immediate ceasefire and hostage release, and framed the deal as relieving Gaza and de-escalating regional tensions. This supports a more peaceful and lawful posture than open escalation.  
  **QIDs:** 2B.10, 2B.7, 2B.6

- **President El-Sisi Speaks with US President Biden** | Presidency of the Republic of Egypt | **Aug. 16, 2024** | https://www.presidency.eg/EN/%D9%82%D8%B3%D9%85_%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1/%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%B1%D8%A6%D8%A7%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A9/1682024-1/  
  Sisi told Biden Egypt was continuing contacts to urge non-escalation and self-restraint, respect sovereignty, and prevent a cycle of violence. This is direct evidence of a stabilizing regional line.  
  **QIDs:** 2B.10, 2B.6, 2B.7

- **Egypt, Qatar and United States call on Israel and Hamas to resume talks next Thursday** | Ahram Online | **Aug. 9, 2024** | https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContentP/1/528836/Egypt/Egypt%2C-Qatar-and-United-States-call-Israel-and-Ham.aspx  
  Reporting on the joint statement emphasizes the call to resume ceasefire talks in Cairo or Doha and close remaining gaps without delay. This reinforces the claim that Egypt was acting as a mediator rather than a spoiler.  
  **QIDs:** 2B.10, 2B.7

- **Egypt raises preparedness level in northern Sinai, security sources say** | Reuters via MarketScreener | **May 6, 2024** | https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Egypt-raises-preparedness-level-in-northern-Sinai-security-sources-say-46636165/  
  Egypt raised military preparedness in northern Sinai after Israel’s Rafah operation. That reads as defensive spillover management, but it also shows the region remained volatile rather than clearly more stable.  
  **QIDs:** 2B.10, 2B.8, 2B.4

- **Egypt’s second weapons shipment to Somalia deepens dam dispute with Ethiopia** | The National | **Sep. 24, 2024** | https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2024/09/24/egypts-second-weapons-shipment-to-somalia-deepens-dam-conflict-with-ethiopia/  
  Egypt’s second weapons shipment to Somalia, delivered under a military accord, drew Ethiopian warnings that it could destabilize the Horn of Africa. This is the clearest contrary evidence against a broad “more peaceful and lawful” conclusion.  
  **QIDs:** 2B.10, 2B.8, 2B.5

- **President El-Sisi Inaugurates Egypt International Airshow (EIAS) 2024** | State Information Service | **Sep. 3, 2024** | https://sis.gov.eg/en/media-center/events/president-el-sisi-inaugurates-egypt-international-airshow-eias-2024/  
  Egypt hosted a major airshow featuring defense hardware and industrial power projection, which is more consistent with prestige signaling than regional demilitarization. It does not prove aggression, but it cuts against a clean stability-lowering reading.  
  **QIDs:** 2B.10, 2B.8

**Search gap**
I did not find a rigorous before/after metric showing that regional relations in 2024 were objectively more peaceful or lawful than in early 2024. The evidence is event-based: strong de-escalation in Gaza, but simultaneous militarized signaling and an arms transfer to Somalia. That makes the overall judgment mixed rather than clearly positive.
